posts.hook: the rocket company just became an ai company
posts.caption: spacex made more money from ai compute than starlink and rockets combined, a leaked tiktok document says it withheld a safety algorithm from millions of us teens, and apple's trade secrets case against openai just widened to 11 more ex employees. full digest at sift.yasint.dev (link in bio)
